newsitem.title: FRANCE: Bomb hits home of south France mayor.
newsitem.headline: Bomb hits home of south France mayor.

text.p: A bomb blast damaged the home of the mayor of the southern French city of Beziers early on Tuesday but no one was hurt, police said.
The bomb was placed outside the house of conservative mayor Raymond Couderc who was in the building at the time with his family.
No one claimed responsibility for the blast but radio France-Info said police suspected disgruntled shopkeepers were to blame.
